title: repo-doctor repository configuration (schema version 1)
description: `.repo-doctor.json`. Overrides fields of the selected profile for one repository. Paths inside it are relative to this file's directory, never the terminal working directory.

profile.description: Relative path to the selected profile file. Must resolve inside the repository root after canonicalization, including symlinks.

rules.description: ruleId -> override. Unspecified fields inherit from the selected profile rule. A rule not selected by the profile must specify both severity and scope. May enable any diagnostic registered by the fixed engine bundle.

exclude.description: Globs that filter reported source locations (not compilation inputs). Case-sensitive, matched on normalized repository-relative paths with '/' separators.
